_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Done: Rising posts for a topic

description: Use this when the user wants what is trending or rising right now, such as "what is trending in AI today?" or "rising posts about postgres this week". Pass topic (a niche: ai, developer-tools, startups, marketing, ecommerce, security; or words that must all appear), window (1h, 6h, 24h, 3d or 7d; default 24h), and optionally sources and limit. Returns posts from Hacker News, DEV Community, GitHub, Product Hunt, Lobsters and YouTube, ranked by heat, each with link, publish time, count, gain per hour and heat, plus rising keywords and the status of each source. Reddit and X are not read.

topic.description: What to look at: a niche (ai, developer-tools, startups, marketing, ecommerce, security) or plain words that must all appear in a post's title or tags, such as "claude code" or "postgres". Leave it out for everything.

name: trending

as_of.description: ISO 8601 time the data was published by its source or fetched from it. A cached answer keeps the time of its fetch.

engagement.description: The source's own count at the last read, in unit

heat.description: 0 to 100, rank against the other posts of the same source

unit.description: points, reactions, stars or views; null for Product Hunt, which publishes no count

change_percent.description: Change of the word's share of titles, last 3 days against the 3 days before

source.description: Who the data comes from, to cite and to check it against.

title: Rising posts for a topic
